title: st.date_input: calendar UI not localized (month/day names remain English) and no locale parameter
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

 The calendar popup of st.date_input is not localized: month/day names and control labels (e.g., “Today”) remain in English. There is
  no parameter to set the widget’s locale (e.g., pt-BR). Only the displayed date format can be customized via format.

  Steps to Reproduce

  1. Set your browser’s primary language to Portuguese (Brazil).
  2. Run:

  import streamlit as st
  from datetime import date

  st.date_input("Data", value=date.today(), format="DD/MM/YYYY")

  3. Open the date picker popup and observe that month/day names and labels are in English.

  Expected Behavior

  - Calendar UI strings (month/day names and labels like “Today”) should be localized based on the client/browser locale, or
  - A public parameter should allow explicitly setting the widget locale (e.g., st.date_input(..., locale="pt-BR")).

  Actual Behavior

  - Only the date format changes. Calendar UI strings remain in English.
  - No locale parameter exists for st.date_input.

  Environment

  - Streamlit: latest
  - Python: 3.12
  - Browser/OS: Chrome on Windows (also reproducible elsewhere)

  Request
  Please add localization support for the calendar UI in st.date_input, either by automatically respecting the client locale or by
  exposing an explicit locale parameter (e.g., locale="pt-BR").
